auth_lifecycle.unauthenticated_behavior: Navigate to login and clear protected navigation state.
auth_lifecycle.forbidden_behavior: Render a permission-safe state without exposing protected data.
auth_lifecycle.logout_behavior: Revoke refresh token and clear secure local credentials.

state_management.server_state_strategy: Repository and observable presentation state own API-derived state.
state_management.ui_state_strategy: Platform presentation state owns ephemeral screen state.
state_management.cache_strategy: Persist only explicitly approved API-backed offline data.

forms_validation.client_validation_strategy: Local validation mirrors contract constraints without redefining server business rules.
forms_validation.api_validation_mapping: Map 422 fields and Problem Details to accessible field/global errors.
forms_validation.conflict_mapping: Map 409 to explicit non-destructive conflict handling.
forms_validation.rate_limit_mapping: Map 429 to Retry-After guidance without retry storms.

observability.client_error_strategy: Attach request ID and route context to sanitized client diagnostics.
observability.pii_policy: Redact credentials and sensitive domain payloads.

accessibility.target: iOS accessibility with WCAG-equivalent interaction principles
accessibility.keyboard_or_switch_navigation: Support keyboard and Switch Control traversal where applicable.
accessibility.screen_reader_or_talkback: VoiceOver semantics and meaningful accessibility labels.
accessibility.focus_management: Restore and move accessibility focus intentionally after navigation, validation and dialogs.

unit.strategy: Domain-facing mapper and presentation-state unit tests.

component_or_ui.strategy: UI tests for permissions, states and accessibility semantics.

integration.strategy: API client, secure credential and auth lifecycle integration tests.

e2e.strategy: Critical slice journeys on simulator/device against a real test API.

offline.storage_strategy: Local persistence stores only approved API-backed entities and explicit mutation queue state.
offline.sync_conflict_policy: Server remains canonical; conflicts require documented merge/retry behavior.
